description: Record one thing the signed-in person tells you, so their style profile learns from it: 'wore' (a garment they own, by item_id from list_wardrobe), 'bought', 'liked' or 'rejected' (a garment they own by item_id, or an outside product by its link or description). `on` is the day it happened, YYYY-MM-DD, today by default, up to 30 days back. Record only what the person said, never a guess. Works only once the person has turned on 'Allow assistants to change my wardrobe' under Profile → Connected assistants in the Alama app; otherwise it refuses and nothing is saved. The same thing on the same day is recorded once.
name: record_signal

about.description: What the fact is about, in words

created.description: False when the same fact was already recorded that day; nothing was doubled
